item.title: A-FACTORY Aomori: Apple Cider & Food Souvenirs — Guide
item.description: A stylish market building right by Aomori Station, A-FACTORY is the essential one-stop for Aomori food culture. A glass-walled cider brewery makes Aomori’s famous apple cider on-site, while the market hall sells apple juice, local sake, dried scallops and the prefecture’s best-curated edible souvenirs. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Aomori City (by Aomori Station) Hours ~10:00–19:00 (varies) Admission Free entry Time needed About 1 hour Best time Year-round What to Do Taste Aomori apple cider from the on-site brewery.
